entities.name: RLF Timers and Constants
entities.description: Configuration parameters for Radio Link Failure timers and constants that can be set to release or specific values.

entities.name: DAPS Bearer
entities.description: Condition indicating whether any Dual Active Protocol Stack bearer is configured in the UE.

entities.name: UE Timers and Constants
entities.description: Default timer and constant values received in SIB1 for timers T301, T310, T311 and constants N310, N311.

entities.name: Timer T301
entities.description: Timer used in radio link failure procedures.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Timer used in radio link failure detection procedures.

entities.name: Timer T311
entities.description: Timer used in radio link failure recovery procedures.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer used in radio link failure procedures for specific cell groups.

entities.name: Counter N310
entities.description: Counter for radio link failure detection events.

entities.name: Counter N311
entities.description: Counter for radio link failure recovery events.

entities.name: Target Cell Group
entities.description: Condition referring to the specific cell group configuration in DAPS bearer scenarios.

relations.description: RLF Timers and Constants configuration depends on whether DAPS bearer is configured.
When DAPS bearer is configured and RLF Timers and Constants is set to release, UE uses values from SIB1.
DAPS bearer configuration requires consideration of target cell group for timer configuration.
RLF Timers and Constants configuration stops timer T310 for the cell group if running.
RLF Timers and Constants configuration stops timer T312 for the cell group if running.
RLF Timers and Constants configuration resets counter N310.
RLF Timers and Constants configuration resets counter N311.
UE Timers and Constants includes values for timer T301.
UE Timers and Constants includes values for timer T310.
UE Timers and Constants includes values for timer T311.
UE Timers and Constants includes values for constant N310.
UE Timers and Constants includes values for constant N311.
